positions.title: Teaching Assistant (CS 1332 Data Structures and Algorithims)
positions.description:
Responsibilities include:
- Leading a weekly extension session for 50 students in Data Structures and Algorithms with co-TA,
- Holding weekly office hours open to over 700 students enrolled in the course, 
- Answering questions posted to class forum (Piazza) and sent via email,
- Grading weekly homework assignments,
- Grading and proctoring tests,
- And providing support to students!

positions.title: Project Rise Up 4 CS Tutor
positions.description: Tutored high school students from underrepresented backgrounds in AP Computer Science via in-person help sessions and video lectures. Also helped coordinate and administer annual AP Bowl, a mock AP CSA exam open to all high school students in the metro Atlanta area. Formerly received tutoring through program.

positions.title: Ivan Allen Freshman Research Intern
positions.description: Worked with Elizabeth Miller, Director of Enrollment and Student Affairs for the Ivan Allen College of Liberal Arts, to study efficacious admissions videos and survey current freshmen attitudes towards these videos. My culminating project was to re-shoot and re-edit an existing publication of the College.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Worked on full stack Android Google Maps team focused on map-based discovery.
- Implemented client and server changes to the Maps codebase by leveraging various internal APIs and gRPCs to meet the needs of a new feature. Also applied external technologies such as Dagger, Protocol Buffers, Annotations and Producer Graphs.
- Emphasized testing with JUnit, Mockito, and logging code changes with internal systems.
- Created comprehensive documentation (including design, experiment, and testing documents) and a preliminary demo to present a new feature to the larger team, including other engineers, UX designers, and a product manager .

positions.title: Engineering Practicum Intern
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented Android applications using Sceneform (tinyurl.com/sceneform-samples)
- Closely collaborated with Google's software engineers, UX team, developer relations team and other interns from initial stages of development to deployment of software.
- Supported Sceneform on Github by answering questions from external users and developing code snippets to assist them.
- Skills used include Augmented Reality App Development, 3D Graphics and Math, Android Development, Java, UI design and Agile Development

positions.title: Computer Science Summer Institute Student
positions.description: Google Computer Science Summer Institute (CSSI) is a three-week intensive summer program for incoming college freshmen. I participated at the Google Atlanta office and spent nearly 150 hours learning Python, JavaScript, JQuery, basic API use, and AppEngine.

honors.title: Georgia Scholar
honors.description: "Students eligible for Georgia Scholar recognition are high school seniors who exhibit excellence in all phases of school life, in community activities, and in the home. Georgia Scholars are students who have carried exemplary course loads during the four years of high school; who performed excellently in all courses; who successfully participated in interscholastic events at their schools and in their communities; and who have assumed active roles in extracurricular activities sponsored by their schools." -- Georgia Department of Education Press Release, 2017
honors.issuer: Issued by Georgia Department of Education · May 2017

volunteerExperiences.description: I assisted at my local middle school's meetings of this book-based quiz bowl as well as serving as a county level volunteer. I previously participated in the club.

projects.title: SpeedyReads
projects.description: During my time at CSSI Atlanta I worked with my teammates to create a web app that allows users to practice speed reading and answer content questions. My focus during this project was back-end development with Python and Google App-engine.
